description: Feature × host matrix for Squad: what each Squad capability depends on, how it is realised per host, and how (if at all) it has been validated.

dependencyClasses.a: squad CLI only (host-agnostic; the host is not involved)
dependencyClasses.b: coordinator-prompt behavior (the section must be present in the host's coordinator file or reachable on demand)
dependencyClasses.c: squad_state / memory.* MCP tools (state-mcp bridge reachable from the host)
dependencyClasses.d: host runtime capability (subagent spawn, background tasks, shell, file ops, sql, per-spawn model, MCP inheritance by subagents)
dependencyClasses.e: platform CLI or MCP availability in the host (gh / glab / az / ADO MCP / GitHub MCP)

capabilities.supported: The host can do this through the stated mechanism, with no known limitation.
capabilities.degraded: The host does this partially: it works, but with the stated limitation (for example a synchronous fallback, an on-demand path, or a host runtime gap).
capabilities.unsupported: The host cannot do this today — including every case where the coordinator section the feature relies on is absent from the host's projected digest. Stays unsupported until the section ships.
capabilities.n/a: Not applicable to this host (a Copilot-only surface or something that runs outside the host).

validationLevels.validated-test: An automated test in this repository asserts the cell (see `evidence`; CLI/SDK tests are host-independent). For `unsupported` digest-gap cells this is the per-host `it.fails` that proves the section is absent.
validationLevels.validated-live: A recorded headless run of the real host CLI against a real model passed on the reference machine (Claude Code and OpenCode only, 2026-10-22); the test-level evidence also applies.
validationLevels.static-only: Only the projected/canonical text or the source was inspected; no automated or live evidence for this cell.
validationLevels.untested: Nothing beyond static reading, and no live attempt was made for this host.
validationLevels.blocked: A live run was attempted for this host and could not complete for an external reason (`blockedReason`); confidence is the same as `untested`.

evidenceKinds.validated-test:<file>::<name>: Automated test (name `*` = the whole file). The title must appear literally in the file.
evidenceKinds.validated-manual:lab:<scenario>@<date>: A recorded live run (see the live run log) for this host and scenario.
evidenceKinds.static-only: Marker: the cell was (also) read statically.

Live evidence exists for Claude Code and OpenCode only (reference machine, 2026-10-22). Kiro, Codex, Antigravity and Cursor have no passing live run: their cells are `validated-test` only through host-independent tests, otherwise `static-only`, `untested` or `blocked`.

The opt-in headless coordinator tests (`SQUAD_REAL_MODEL_TESTS=1`) verify the MCP bridge through a tee'd `squad state-mcp` transcript (a successful `tools/call` of `squad_state_read` with `key: "team.md"`), not by matching stdout. No other cell claims bridge-level verification.
